title: 0.2: Run the model spikes and record results
label: ready-for-human
body:
## Parent

{{spec}}

## What to build

Run the four scripts in `spikes/` on the M2 following `spikes/README.md`, listen to `spikes/out/`, and record in `docs/design.md`: which voice-design engine passes (VoxCPM2, Qwen3-TTS, or neither), whether Emotion preset clips should come from Chatterbox or VoxCPM2 style-cloning, and whether Chatterbox Turbo's vocal effects pass.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Results and the three decisions are written in `docs/design.md` Open questions
- [ ] If neither design engine passes, the spec's upload fallback is marked as active

## Blocked by

None. Can start immediately.

Phase 0, Design and spikes. Log work in `DevNotes/Logs/phase-0.md` under `## Phase 0.2`.

title: 1.1: Project skeleton, config, and test harness
label: ready-for-agent
body:
## Parent

{{spec}}

## What to build

Python 3.11 package with a FastAPI app serving a placeholder page, one command that starts the server and opens the browser, a local config file outside git (app data folder, Output cache size, Freesound key), and the app data folder with subfolders for voices, drafts, sounds, cache, and saved. pytest harness that runs the app in-process against a fresh temporary data folder per test.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] One command starts the app and opens the page
- [ ] Config and data folder are created on first run
- [ ] `pytest` runs one passing API test against a temp data folder

## User stories covered

Spec stories 57, 59.

## Blocked by

None. Can start immediately.

Phase 1, Foundation. Log work in `DevNotes/Logs/phase-1.md` under `## Phase 1.1`.

title: 1.3: Job runner, engine interfaces, and model manager
label: ready-for-agent
body:
## Parent

{{spec}}

## What to build

One-at-a-time background job runner with job status, progress, and result endpoints. Starting a second job returns 409. Model load and out-of-memory errors end the job with a readable error. Define the voice design, speech, and vocal-effect engine interfaces with fakes that return short distinguishable WAVs, and a model manager that keeps at most one large model loaded. Ship the vocal-effect engine that supports no effects.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Status shows progress and the result or error
- [ ] Second job gets 409
- [ ] Tests swap all engines for fakes

## User stories covered

Spec stories 15, 48, 49, 58, 60.

## Blocked by

- {{1.1}} (step 1.1)

Phase 1, Foundation. Log work in `DevNotes/Logs/phase-1.md` under `## Phase 1.3`.

title: 1.4: Chatterbox speech engine
label: ready-for-agent
body:
## Parent

{{spec}}

## What to build

Real speech engine on chatterbox-mlx (hybrid-mlx): text + Reference clip + exaggeration + cfg to WAV, using the long-text path above about 50 words. Loads once at startup; the model manager unloads and reloads it around other engines. Add the slow, hand-run smoke test scaffold (excluded from the default test run).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Smoke test renders a short line and a 120-word passage on the M2
- [ ] Default `pytest` run never loads a real model

Spec stories 45, 58.

title: 2.2: Design a Draft voice
label: ready-for-agent
body:
## Parent

{{spec}}

## What to build

Real voice-design engine chosen in 0.2. Designing a Draft voice is a job: generate the neutral Reference clip (about 15 s) from the description, then one Emotion preset per default emotion cloned from it (method chosen in 0.2). Draft voices live in the draft area. If 0.2 activated the fallback, this step instead creates the neutral clip from an uploaded recording through the converter.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Job produces a Draft voice with a neutral clip and every default preset
- [ ] Clips are fetchable through the API

## User stories covered

Spec stories 1, 2, 3, 15.
